conclusion.summary: This comprehensive technical plan provides a complete roadmap for building Blocked, an enterprise-grade interview security platform based on a native Chromium fork browser. The architecture leverages native browser process modifications for robust security monitoring, eliminating the limitations of browser extensions. The system combines real-time video processing, eye tracking, AI answer detection, and behavioral analysis to provide comprehensive interview integrity assurance.

key_advantages.advantage: Native Chromium integration provides deep system access impossible with extensions
Multi-layered detection (visual, behavioral, AI) provides high confidence results
Scalable microservices architecture supports thousands of concurrent interviews
Cost-optimized with intelligent caching and self-hosted components
Production-ready with monitoring, CI/CD, and enterprise compliance
